test_title: PYST 50 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice.

She said to them, "You will be surprised."

options.text: She told them that they would be surprised.
She told them that you would be surprised.
She told them that they will be surprised.
She told them that she would be surprised.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. She told them that they would be surprised. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is expressed in direct speech and needs to be converted into indirect speech.
 
• In indirect speech, the pronouns and tenses are changed according to the rules of reported speech.
 
• In this case, the reporting verb "said to" is changed to "told," and the tense of the verb "will be" is changed to "would be" because the reporting verb is in the past tense.
 
• The pronoun "you" changes to "they" to maintain consistency with the subject "them."

Correct sentence: *She told them that they would be surprised.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rules for Changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:**

 
 
• **Change of pronouns:** Pronouns in the direct speech are changed to match the subject and context of the reporting clause.
 
• **Change of tense:** If the reporting verb is in the past tense, the tense of the verb in the direct speech is shifted to the past tense (e.g., "will" changes to "would").
 
• **Reporting verb change:** "Said to" is often replaced with "told" when the indirect speech includes an object (e.g., "them").
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Direct: She said, "I am happy."
 
• Indirect: She said that she was happy.
